title: Belrog shot plan
description: The single contract between the input layer (Suno m4a -> plan.json) and the output layer (plan.json -> LTX-2.3 clips -> stitched video). This file is the ONE definition of a shot plan: the app, the validator, the LLM response_format, and the grammar builder all use THIS file and never a paraphrase of it. GBNF subset by law (V11): objects, strings, numbers, integers, booleans, enums, arrays, required, additionalProperties:false. No $ref, oneOf, anyOf, allOf, patternProperties, if/then, format or pattern - a grammar builder cannot express them and constrained decoding fails silently when asked. Every enum id comes from src/config/musicVideoShotConfig.js; ids marked pending are added to that config by W-A step 4 and are enforced by tests/shotPlanSchema.test.mjs. Optional field means 'not applicable' - never send null to mean absent, because a nullable union is not in the GBNF subset.

path.description: Absolute path to the source audio file.

durationSec.description: Measured duration in seconds, never estimated.

hash.description: Content hash, used to bind cached analysis to this exact file.

beats.description: Beat or onset times in ascending seconds. Cuts snap to these.

sections.description: Song sections detected from the audio envelope, ascending by startSec, contiguous.

energy.description: Normalized 0..1 measured loudness for this section.

profileSource.description: Where timing came from. 'envelope' is the default path; even line spread is not an option (V6).

preset.description: Style card id from MUSIC_VIDEO_STYLE_CARD_OPTIONS. 'mtv-1990s' is pending that config's extension.

film.description: Film stock and grain. Verbatim in every shot that does not override it.

letterbox.description: Aspect treatment, e.g. a 2.35:1 anamorphic matte.

lighting.description: The look's lighting grammar, stated once and reused verbatim.

slug.description: Referenced by shots.locationOverride and by the validator.

lock.description: The canonical location description. Emitted verbatim wherever this location appears so it can never be re-described differently between shots (V5).

props.description: Props declared once at track level, referenced by slug from shots.

lock.description: Canonical prop description, verbatim on every appearance.

cast.description: People only. Production and mixing directions are NEVER cast (V4).

slug.description: Matched by shots.cast and by the DSL 'Artist:' line.

lock.description: Canonical identity: face, build, hair, wardrobe baseline. Verbatim everywhere this person appears.

wardrobe.description: Costume name active unless wardrobeAt says otherwise.

wardrobeAt.description: Section ids where this costume applies.

refImage.description: Optional reference image path. Omit entirely when identity is prompt-only (D5).

shots.description: The rendered shot list, ascending by startSec. Every field the generator needs is a typed field here; nothing is re-parsed from prose.

id.description: Stable shot id, referenced by clips.shotIds.

cameraMove.description: MUSIC_VIDEO_CAMERA_MOVE_OPTIONS plus the 1990s grammar pending in W-A step 4.

cast.description: Cast slugs on screen. Empty for b-roll with nobody in it.

props.description: Prop slugs, each declared under look.location.props (V4).

lyric.description: The lyric line this shot carries, verbatim. Required on lip-sync shots (V7). Omit for shots with no vocal.

action.description: What happens on screen, in prose. This is the field the imagination LLM writes and the only prose a shot owns.

locationOverride.description: Slug of an alternative declared location. Omit to inherit look.location (V5).

film.description: Per-shot override of look.film. Omit to inherit.

lighting.description: Per-shot override of look.lighting. Omit to inherit.

clips.description: Generation units actually queued, derived from shots by the timeline builder and never hand-written. This is what stops shot count and clip count disagreeing.

lengthSec.description: Frame-grid aligned length. Residual is carried to the next clip, never rounded away (V1).

shotIds.description: Shots contained in this clip, in time order. Their prompt is what the generator receives.

backend.description: Which imagination backend wrote the prose (D3). local = bundled llama-server sidecar, lmstudio = external local server, openrouter = cloud fallback.

modelId.description: Model id or GGUF filename that produced the prose. Recorded so a render can say which model wrote it.

endpoint.description: Base URL used, including the sidecar's ephemeral port.

pid.description: Sidecar process id, for lifecycle and post-mortem.

grammarEnforced.description: True when the schema constrained token generation rather than being checked afterward.

repairRetries.description: Parse-failure repairs used, 0 or 1 (one is the ceiling).
